evidence.reason: The fixture `git()` helper runs Git with `cwd` but no sanitized environment. Inherited `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_INDEX_FILE`, or `GIT_WORK_TREE` override `cwd`, so `git add`/`git commit` can act on the caller’s repository or index instead of the fixture, e.g. when tests run from a Git hook. The CLI child helper has the same inherited-environment issue. This is a routine test-isolation repair, not a new requirement or owner decision.
